payload.reason: The evidence provides specific methods and results related to tuning a per-word reward using the perceptron algorithm in neural machine translation.

claims.text: A per-word reward can be tuned using a perceptron-like method, which is a quick post-training step.
The optimal value of the per-word reward is sensitive to various factors such as task, beam size, and dataset.
Tuning the word reward score generally yields better performance metrics compared to length normalization in certain settings.
